about.title: About Inferenco – The Team Behind the Products
about.p1: Inferenco is a software company formed through the collaboration of Singularity Shift Ltd and Spielcrypto Ltd. We build products, not client projects — everything on this site is designed, built, and shipped by us.
about.p2: Our product line starts with games and everyday media apps and runs through on-chain wallets, dApps, and developer tooling — all backed by security reviews and signed releases.
about.p3: Every product is maintained by the same team that wrote it — with documentation, install guides, and a direct line to the developers.

gallery.subtitle: A mobile Go game and two free, privacy-first web tools — no accounts needed, and nothing leaves your device unless you ask it to.

nemesis.name: Nemesis Go
nemesis.blurb: A 9×9 Go game for Android with an offline, on-device AI opponent and move analysis. No account, no connection required — your saved games and preferences stay on your device.

sound.name: Sound Flipper
sound.blurb: A free audio converter that works entirely in your browser — your recordings and songs never get uploaded. Convert between MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and more, with no account or software installation required.

image.name: Make My Image Fit
image.blurb: A free, privacy-first image resizer and compressor that runs entirely in your browser — no uploads, no account. Set a maximum file size or exact pixel dimensions and it prepares up to 10 images to pass any upload form's requirements.

nemesis.long: Nemesis Go is a 9×9 Go game for Android that runs entirely on your device. The computer opponent and the analysis behind move suggestions both work offline, so you can play anywhere without an account or a connection. Your saved games, recent results, and preferences are kept on your device, so you can close the app mid-game and pick the same board up later. The game is free to play and supported by ads shown between games; you can also choose to watch an ad when you want a hint or to undo your last move. An optional monthly Remove ads subscription turns in-app ads off and gives you direct access to Hint and Undo.

sound.long: Sound Flipper (soundflipper.com) is a free online audio converter for recordings, songs, and other sound files already saved on your device — everything is processed locally in your browser, so your audio stays private. Its inspector reads the actual audio inside and tells you exactly what it detects, refusing unsupported files with a clear explanation. You can convert up to ten files at once between MP3, WAV, M4A/AAC, FLAC, ALAC, AIFF, Ogg Vorbis, and Opus, with sensible quality settings resolved automatically. It's ideal for fixing rejected uploads — e.g. turning a voice memo into MP3 — and comes with step-by-step conversion guides. Currently offered as a testable preview, free with no sign-up.

resize.long: Make My Image Fit (resizeandcompress.app) is a free online image utility that compresses, resizes, and converts images without ever uploading them — all processing happens on your device in the browser. You can process up to 10 images at once (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, AVIF, HEIC, or DNG), set a maximum file size in KB/MB and/or exact pixel dimensions, and choose the output format. Before you download, the tool checks each result against your requirements, and you can rotate, set backgrounds, or convert HEIC phone photos and DNG RAW files on-device. Results download individually or as a ZIP. It's completely free with no sign-up, and no analytics or ads load without consent.
